scripts.score: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/cues.mts > scripts/cues.json && python3 scripts/make_score.py scripts/cues.json public/trailer/score.wav
scripts.level-audio: python3 scripts/level_audio.py public/footage/raw48.wav public/footage/leveled.wav && remotion ffmpeg -y -i public/footage/leveled.wav -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -ar 48000 -c:a pcm_s16le public/footage/audio-leveled.wav
scripts.render:full: remotion render FullVideo out/day-in-the-life-edited.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=20 && remotion ffmpeg -y -i out/day-in-the-life-edited.mp4 -i public/footage/audio-leveled.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 192k -movflags +faststart -shortest out/day-in-the-life-final.mp4
